description: This file contains a PHP class 'CustomerReward' that handles the customer reward report functionality within the admin area of an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for rendering report pages, saving settings, and generating report data, utilizing OpenCart's MVC structure and configurations.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Handles the customer reward report in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering views, saving configuration, and generating report data with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the customer reward report configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report configuration settings via POST request.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer reward report list, typically used for AJAX or partial updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the customer reward report data with filters and pagination, returning a view.
